code:
import shap

# Tree models -- fast, exact
explainer = shap.TreeExplainer(model)
shap_values = explainer(X_test)

# Any model -- slower, approximate
explainer = shap.Explainer(model, X_train)
shap_values = explainer(X_test)

print(shap_values[0])              # one prediction's SHAP values
print(shap_values[0].base_values)  # the baseline
caption: TreeExplainer computes exact Shapley values for tree models; Explainer works on any model type but is slower.
